# Synthetic schema 1.0.0 inputs

`example.geocsv` is the complete specification example. `typed.geocsv` contains
its first two records. `synthetic.geocsv` and `indexed.geocsv` are invented valid
single-instrument inputs; tests explicitly modify their in-memory tables to
exercise invalid projections, multiple identities and nanosecond matching grids.
They are demonstrations, not observed instrument histories. Original older
fixtures remain unchanged as historical evidence.
